classification: STATIC COMPILED LAMP-PATTERN WORD ONLY: the 24-byte extension allocation and one same-size caller token were emitted in memory and the ordered integrity fields were repaired. The only predicted lamp effect from this word is frame-buffer bit 01 at 010F/011F/012F/013F for index 00 and pattern 8F. The reused original service also reads DP-relative 00F1, conditionally writes 00F1 and 080C, masks IRQ/FIRQ around its 0801/0802/0803 access, pushes and pulls U/S frames, saves and restores Y, and changes A/CC net; 49C5 preserves A/B/X only within its own prologue/epilogue. No whole-RAM-unchanged, safe-caller, natural-boot, execution or hardware claim is made.

limitations: The new word was not naturally executed. The 010F/011F/012F/013F frame update is a static lamp-effect prediction; no full response byte is claimed.

The reused service reads DP-relative 00F1, conditionally writes 00F1/080C, masks IRQ/FIRQ around 0801/0802/0803, moves U/S frames and changes A/CC net. No whole-RAM unchanged or safe-caller claim is made.
Natural safety of the 9C44/49C5 characteriser/PIA/scratch/IRQ side effects at the 9F14 caller is unproved.

MAME layout checked by supervisor: feature-grid outputs run 64..69, 72..77, ... 120..125 top-to-bottom; output = 64 + 8*topRow + column, so 72BF index 0 (output 120) is bottom-left START. Physical orientation/hardware remains separate and unproved.
M5 remains open; this is one new definition plus one same-size caller redirect.
No MAME boot, capture, synthetic invocation, save state, debugger write, gameplay, paid window or hardware validation is included.
